اختطين (form VIII)
# اِخْتَطَيْنَ (iḵtaṭayna) /ix.ta.tˤaj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# اُخْتُطِينَ (uḵtuṭīna) /ux.tu.tˤiː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# اِخْتَطِينَ (iḵtaṭīna) /ix.ta.tˤiː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
